t: A Baltic duchy on the lower Oder ruled by the Slavic Griffin dynasty from the 1120s until 1637.
Converted by Otto of Bamberg, it became an imperial fief and absorbed German settlers and Hanseatic towns.
When the last duke died in the Thirty Years’ War, Sweden and Brandenburg divided the duchy in 1648.
dyk: A Griffin prince, Eric of Pomerania, became king of Denmark, Norway and Sweden in 1397, and later ended his days as a minor duke in Pomerania.
ev: Bolesław III of Poland conquers Pomerania; Wartislaw I becomes a Polish vassal
Otto of Bamberg begins his mission to convert the Pomeranians
Bogislaw I receives Pomerania as an imperial fief from Frederick Barbarossa
The duchy is divided into Pomerania-Stettin and Pomerania-Wolgast
A diet at Treptow adopts the Lutheran Reformation
Bogislaw XIV dies, the last Griffin duke
The Peace of Westphalia divides Pomerania between Sweden and Brandenburg

f.capital: Szczecin (Stettin); also Wolgast and other ducal seats
f.predecessor: Pomeranian Slavic tribes; Kingdom of Poland (overlord)
